svg.title: Great Lakes traffic falls by half in winter; the ocean coasts barely change

cc:Work.dc:title: Great Lakes traffic falls by half in winter; the ocean coasts barely change
cc:Work.dc:description: Four line charts of large ships per sampled day for the Great Lakes, Atlantic, Gulf, and Pacific; only the Great Lakes line dips sharply each winter.
